tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pas mdo sde du ma nas lung gis bsngags pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs 'grel rigs tshogs kyi bstan bcos kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab 'di nyid kyi dgongs 'grel thal rang gi gzhung so sor bzhugs yod pa las/ ches khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa shes kyi dgongs pa rang rkang du 'grel pa don 'grel dbu ma 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan 'grel du mdzad pa tshig 'grel tshig gsal rnams yin te/ dbu ma dwags brgyud grub pa'i shing rta las/ 'o na slob dpon chen po de dag gis dbu ma'i dgongs pa 'grel ba na/ phyi nang gi mu stegs byed kyi blo'i spobs pa myur ba myur bar bcom pa la blo'i nus pa su che zhe na/ dpal mar me mdzad kyi zhal snga nas/ slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa'i zhabs nyid 'gran zla dang bral lo/ /zhes gsungs la/ de ltar don du'ang gnas pas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis las skabs su bab pa dbu ma la 'jug pa'i gzhung 'di ni/ rgya che ba snying rje la sogs pa'i chos gsum/ rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu/ sa bcu po de dag gi yon tan/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan rnams rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ zab pa stong pa nyid bdag med pa'i don/ gtso bo rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas mtha' bzhi yi skye ba bkag nas chos kyi bdag med pa'i gnas lugs gsal bar bstan pa dang*/ shing rta rnam bdun gyi rigs pas gang zag gi bdag med pa'i gnas lugs shin tu gsal bar bstan pa ste/ zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis kyi sgo nas dbu ma rtsa ba'i dgongs don dri ma med pa gsal bar gtan la phab pa'i gzhung khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin/ gzhung 'di nyid kyi dgongs 'grel 'phags bod gnyis su nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar grangs su ma mchis par bzhugs yod pa las kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dbu ma dwags brgyud grub pa'i shing rta 'di ni sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i gsung dang sbyar nas rang lugs thun mong min pa'i khyad chos du ma brtsal du bton pa'i dgongs 'grel khyad par du 'phags pa yin par brten/

bka' drin bla na ma mchis pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 7skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog nas/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rang 'grel 'di la dbu ma dwags brgyud grub shing gi sa bcad sbyar te par du bskrun na/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i rang 'grel 'di nyid la thos bsam gnang ba'i tshe 'chad nyan gyi 'jug pa bde ba sogs phan brlabs che ba yod ces bka' bstsal don ltar/ badz+ra bid+yā'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi dge slong tshe ring mchog nas/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rang 'grel 'di nyid la sde dge par ma gzhir bzung zhus dag gang mang dang*/ kar ṭīka gi sa bcad rnams sbyar te go sgrig gnang ba dang*/ rang dgon gyi sprul sku dam chos mchog nas deb 'di'i 'gro gron yongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyin bdag gnang ba dang*/ badz+ra bid+yā'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi slob gnyer ba blo gros rab rgyas nas deb gzugs dang rgyab shog bkod bsgrigs gnang ba bcas la rjes su yi rangs dang bkrin shin tu che/ gzhan yang yi ge lhag chad dang nor ba go rim 'khrugs pa sogs mkhyen ldan yangs pa'i spyan sngar bshags shing bka' slob lhug bstsol yod par mkhyen/ badz+ra bid+yā'i gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi slob dge ba shes rab phun tshogs nas/ phyi lo 2005 zla ba 10 tshes 22 la/
